Question 3
?

Given that u=x−1, which integral is equivalent to ∫xx−15dx?

a
∫(u6/5+u1/5)du
b
∫u1/5du
c
∫(u6/5−u1/5)du
d
∫u6/5du
e
∫(u1/5+u−1/5)du
